verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk export of workspace data in open formats or an offboarding path. The MCP server's ability to list audits and evidence requests is an adjacent building block, not a full-data export, and the docs actually frame MCP as a way to avoid exporting data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
